description:
The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

 *“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”*

Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.

 *"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”*

From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.

 *“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”*

What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)
